name: threadlight
description: An observable, recoverable, provider-neutral agent runtime and desktop client.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @threadlight/desktop && npm run build --workspace @threadlight/web && npm run build --workspace @threadlight/site
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @threadlight/desktop
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build:packages && npm run package --workspace @threadlight/desktop
scripts.desktop:preview: npm run build:packages && npm run preview --workspace @threadlight/desktop
scripts.web:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @threadlight/web --
scripts.web:build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @threadlight/web
scripts.web:preview: npm run web:build && npm run preview --workspace @threadlight/web
scripts.site:preview: npm run site:build && npm run preview --workspace @threadlight/site
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 pages deploy apps/site/dist --project-name threadlight --branch main
scripts.telemetry:report: npx --yes wrangler@4.120.0 d1 execute threadlight-telemetry --remote --file apps/site/queries/funnel.sql
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace @threadlight/desktop && npm run typecheck --workspace @threadlight/web
scripts.host:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run host --
scripts.cli:dev: npm run build:packages && npm run cli --
